Dana Whitaker needs a concise July 25, 2025 workload view before the Nashville General Hospital Main Campus clinic-relocation readiness huddle. Review the Wayfinding Checklist in the NGH Main Campus Clinic Relocation Operations Workbook and quantify the actual control population rather than counting headings, guidance, or other non-control lines.

In your final response, state the total number of wayfinding controls, how many are marked complete and how many remain incomplete, the resulting completion rate, and how many of the incomplete controls are critical priority. Keep the response read-only and concise, but include the key figures and blocked-control details so the huddle lead can use it directly.

cells: Verify a coordinated journey from home to transportation, parking, campus entrance, public interior routes, destination identification, staff assistance, and the return journey using consistent names, landmarks, maps, directories, graphics, lighting, and digital content.
Readiness window: July 8-25, 2025 | First-day monitoring: July 28, 2025 | Public office hours: Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m.-4:30 p.m.
Controlled source: International Health Facility Guidelines 2023 Part W: Wayfinding Guidelines, published by TAHPI. Treat wayfinding as the complete journey, not only interior signs.
Open actions remain owner- and date-specific. Yellow cells indicate an item requiring active follow-up before first-day operations.
